limitations_and_boundaries: The DAG search method is feasible only for very small networks (roughly N ≤ 7) and suffers from multiple hypothesis testing.
The method assumes additive noise and independence of noise variables; real data may violate these assumptions.
The regression method (Gaussian Process) assumes Gaussian noise, which is inconsistent with the general setting preferring non-Gaussian noise.
The method may accept both directions or reject both, indicating model mismatch.
